dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional — segment labels for each donut slice. If omitted, each Value measure becomes its own slice.

dataRoles.name: detail
dataRoles.description: Optional detail category used to split each segment into an inner ring.

dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: Numeric value for each donut segment. Multiple measures are supported; without a Category, each measure becomes its own slice.
